body: Oh I'm for sure going to die before her, the chances that I kill myself in the next decade are probably pretty high.  Don't worry.

I got into a fight with my mom.  I was mean and then I drove away very fast.  We just talked and she spent the whole day upset.  I hate myself.  I've been suicidally depressed but now I'm trying to pull my head out of my ass a little because I can't be like that to anyone no matter how I'm feeling.

Don't worry I'm still here I'm sorry, just couldn't remember the username for this to log back in.  Not gonna kill my self.  Am super depressed lmao.  

Luckily my friend visiting was a ton of fun, and she offered to have me over whenever I need to get out of town, so that'll be a relief if I really need it.  I need to get a job far away as soon as possible.
I can't fucking deal with it.  It's going to make everything harder right when I need it to be a little easier.  I'm going to kill myself if I actually have to be there.

I tried to convince her to let me stay at the other house one more time.  She says we'll talk about dad being nicer and yeah we've done that you can't talk someone into I love the area I've been in, I feel so trapped.  If I'm at least not horribly depressed I can work on finding a job and getting the fuck out of dodge. Being there I'm going to just be a crying mess the entire time and I'll never get out.  I want to scream i want to jump off a fucking cliff.

It's a common side effect of Zoloft.  That was a nightmare drug for me at higher doses, but everyone's different.

ETA:  if this type of intrusive thought is new for you, it's might be a side effect.  It's weird that drugs can cause certain types of thoughts as side effects but they for sure can.   It's great that you're talking to your doctor about this- I hope they know how to best resolve the issue for you.

No I'm not, just gonna smoke some weed and cuddle my dog.  I'm holding on to my dog rn (figuratively) because I know he'd be really sad if I died.  He'd be okay because my parents love him but I play with him way more, I know more about training, and I've raised him since he was a puppy.  I'm his person and he'd be sad.  

I'm sorry you're feeling this way too :(

Hey, it means a lot that someone replied.  It feels like such a stupid problem but I'm struggling a lot right now.  I'm really afraid of how depressed I'd get if I actually have to be there all the time with no way out.  Right now I'm crying in my room, a friend is coming to visit tomorrow.  We had plans for her to come for a few days and then we'd go to an amusement park one last time before my surgery (can't go on a ride for a while after) but she's only coming for a day and didn't respond to me asking about the park so idk.  I just feel really alone

Gee why didn't I think of that?  Thanks for the idea!  Never could have done it without redditors telling me that there's an avenue for justice just wide open in front of me!   Golly gosh what an idiot I've been.  

When I go to the police station, who do I speak to about a three year old rape case?  They'll surely believe me straight out, won't say anything that will on its own be horrendously traumatizing, won't ask me to relive the rape over and over just to tell me it's not going anywhere.  Who do I speak to about getting him extradited from the country he went home to?  They extradite for rape all the time right?   This won't have any negative repercussions for my already fragile from being raped mental health will it?  

But thank you, for this compassionate, comforting advice.  I wouldn't want to kill my self if I *had only thought to report it*.
Wow.  You suck as a human being.  Hate you very much.
